eventDescription:
With the financial support of Puthiya Thalaimurai Television, the Vidhaigal Charitable Trust has, for the first time, initiated a waterbody restoration project.
The event was graced by managers from Puthiya Thalaimurai Foundation, the Panchayat President, and the local villagers, who participated and made the occasion special.
